subject.title: Dashboard: Living Answers — the agent answers with live widgets, not prose

question: Should Living Answers be accepted as bundled dashboard behavior, kept as a ClawHub skill/convention, or folded back into the modular dashboard tracker?
rationale: The request mixes an agent-facing convention, dashboard schema/store behavior, and Control UI affordances; VISION.md supports web/frontend ergonomics but routes new skills and optional capability through plugins or ClawHub unless maintainers choose otherwise.

options.title: Keep As Roadmap Item
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical Living Answers item and sequence it after the dashboard substrate/security review.

options.title: Move Convention To ClawHub First
options.body: Treat the prompt-layer convention as a ClawHub skill or bundle first, and defer bundled schema/UI changes until usage proves the need.

options.title: Fold Into Tracker
options.body: Move the unique TTL/pin/Answers-tab details into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101136 and close this only if maintainers want one roadmap item instead of separate work items.

recommendation.title: Keep As Roadmap Item
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical Living Answers item and sequence it after the dashboard substrate/security review.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision affects current-main Control UI/plugin boundaries that recent history ties to this area, while the contributor owns the proposal details.
